notes: DCA obligation was 220; borough committed to 171 per binding resolution (January 28, 2025); Program Recommendation by Judge Mendez (April 17, 2025) set obligation at 190. FSHC mediation agreement December 23, 2025 increased maximum redevelopment density from 28 to 32 du/ac with 20% set-aside regardless of tenure. Planning Board adopted amended HEFSP January 27, 2026; Council endorsed February 3, 2026. Present Need = 0. Prior Round (111 units) and Third Round (234 units RDP=35 Unmet Need=199) obligations carried forward. Fourth Round VLA: RDP=4, Unmet Need=186. Key sites: (1) Patterson Street Redevelopment Area (Blocks 1207-1212 = Claremont/Patterson Street Urban Renewal) — 256 total / 20 affordable, 20% at 32 du/ac; (2) Block 1205 Lots 10&11 (100-101 West Street) — 18 total / 4 affordable, TC-2 zoning (Ordinance 2604); (3) Block 1102 Bank of America — 27 total / 4 affordable; (4) 175 Broadway Verizon — 40 total / 6 affordable; (5) 40 Central Avenue — 1 affordable.
